description.value: Turks Coffee Bar is a Commercial Drive outpost of Milano Coffee, a Vancouver-founded roaster with over 30 years of Italian-tradition espresso heritage and 15 international gold medals from the IIAC. The café sits on one of East Vancouver's most celebrated cycling streets, offering a range of meticulously blended espresso and drip options from a chain that roasts in-house in Mount Pleasant. Milano is known for its espresso tasting bars, where customers can sample multiple blends side by side.
